errors.versionIdsRequired: from and to version IDs are required.
errors.sameVersion: A version cannot be compared with itself.
errors.textNotReady: The text comparison has not finished yet.
errors.notReady: The comparison has not finished yet.
errors.aiUnavailable: AI is not available in this project.
errors.notInReview: This version is not in this review, or the review is not running.
errors.unsupportedType: This file type cannot be compared (.{{extension}}). Supported: PDF, XLSX, CSV, DOCX, TXT, DWG, DXF, IFC.
errors.mixedTypes: Both files must be of the same type (e.g. PDF and PDF).
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large ({{mb}} MB); the limit is {{limit}} MB.
errors.preparing: Preparing the comparison; the model index is being built. Try again shortly.
errors.xlsxNoSheets: The XLSX file has no worksheets.
errors.docxInvalid: Not a valid DOCX file (word/document.xml is missing).

notes.noText: No text layer; visual comparison only.
notes.pagesLimited: Text was compared on the first {{pages}} pages only.

flags.identical: The two versions are identical (same file).
flags.noText: No text layer; only a visual comparison was made.
flags.revisionUnknown: No revision could be read in the title block; the revision check was not possible.
flags.revisionNotUpdated: The content changed but the revision did not ({{revision}}). The revision cloud/table may not have been updated.
flags.revisionWithoutChange: The revision changed ({{from}} → {{to}}) but no content change was found outside the title block.
flags.revisionTableNotUpdated: The revision is now {{revision}} but the last row of the revision table is "{{row}}"; the table may not have been updated.
flags.revisionTableEmpty: The revision is now {{revision}} but the last row of the revision table is empty; the table may not have been updated.

summary.noTextDiffVisualPending: No text differences found; the visual comparison runs in the browser.

ai.interrupted: The summary was interrupted (the server may have restarted); start it again.
ai.externalProvider: External provider: {{name}}. Only the difference summary is sent.
ai.writing: The model is writing… ({{chars}} characters, {{seconds}} s)
ai.emptySummary: The model returned an empty summary.

report.title: Revision Comparison Report
report.aiSummary: AI summary ({{model}}); do not decide without checking it.
report.legend: Red: in the old version but not in the new one; blue: newly added; grey: unchanged.
report.pageOnlyNew: Page {{page}} · only in the new version
report.pageNotInNew: Page {{page}} · not in the new version

modelReport.title: Model comparison: {{file}} V{{from}} → V{{to}}
modelReport.oldIndex: The model index is in the old format; no storey or property details.

errors.timeout: The drawing comparison took too long and was stopped.
errors.binaryDxf: Binary DXF files cannot be compared; save the drawing as an ASCII DXF or DWG.
errors.versionGone: One of the versions was deleted.
errors.notPrepared: The versions could not be prepared for comparison in time. Try again with ↻.
errors.dxfFailed: The drawing could not be read: {{error}}
errors.needsQueue: Drawings and models are compared in the background job queue.
errors.notVersionComparison: This comparison has no list of differences (it is not a DWG or IFC comparison).
errors.notReady: The comparison has not finished yet.
errors.noAiSummary: Drawings and models have a rule-based summary only.
errors.useExport: Drawings and models are exported as a list of differences (CSV / Excel).

summary.matchedByGeometry: The entity handles differ between the versions (the drawing was probably re-created); entities were matched by geometry, so changes show as removed + added.
summary.noGeometry: Shapes were not compared: the model index of a version predates shape fingerprints and could not be rebuilt.
